limits: Reviewed retained files only; no fresh SDK execution, provider call or upstream verification was performed.
Alternative SDK evidence is limited to the retained source review and metadata.
Historical execution does not establish acceptance on this host or arbitrary SDK versions.
open_gaps: No matched execution compares the candidate SDKs on structured events, custom tools or session control.
The Codex receipt demonstrates a bounded programmatic worker with existing MCP tools; it does not establish arbitrary custom-tool registration or complete event handling.
SDK cancellation, provider billing cessation, distributed recovery and exactly-once effects remain unqualified.
The recorded file-tool scope failure and subsequent approval-blocked override remain unresolved acceptance boundaries.
CLI session-resume evidence does not independently qualify SDK resume behavior.

arms: A candidate SDK implementing the same bounded task and explicitly required event, tool or session-control behavior
overturn_protocol.metric: Exact task-result correctness, required SDK behavior, effective settings and permission fidelity, failure recovery, elapsed time and complete reported usage; retain failures and unknown usage.

overturn_when: Execute the native replay documented in blueprints/us-equities/workers/README.md using blueprints/us-equities/workers/native_worker.py, then a matched candidate SDK trial. Change the verdict if the candidate satisfies a concrete required event, custom-tool or session-control behavior that Codex fails, while preserving task correctness and permission boundaries. Alternative comparison adapters are not established by the retained evidence.
why_selected: Select c4 within its demonstrated programmatic-worker scope. blueprints/us-equities/workers/receipt.json retains native SDK execution that completed a bounded source-extraction task through Context Mode tools, while preserving a failed file-tool call. The inspected integration in blueprints/us-equities/workers/native_worker.py starts a thread, reads configured model/provider state and submits a turn. docs/foundation-closure-20260921.md retains this working integration while identifying the other SDKs as unqualified or conditional. This establishes an executed SDK baseline, not comparative superiority across all SDK features.
